description: Repo-scale (shell-toolkit): deploy.sh must back up config/app.conf via the existing backup_file helper AND abort if the backup fails
prompts: Before deploying, `deploy.sh` must back up `config/app.conf` using the existing `backup_file` helper (lib/backup.sh already defines it, but nothing currently calls it), passing the deployed `$VERSION` as the backup suffix. It's not enough to just call it - deploy.sh must check the exit code and abort with a non-zero exit (without proceeding to the deploy log line) if the backup fails, e.g. because the config file is missing.

test_setup_files.check_backup.py:
import os
import subprocess

r = subprocess.run(['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', '1.2.3'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert r.returncode == 0, (r.stdout, r.stderr)
assert os.path.isfile('config/app.conf.bak.1.2.3'), (
    'expected deploy.sh to back up config/app.conf before deploying')

os.remove('config/app.conf')
r2 = subprocess.run(['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', '1.2.3'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert r2.returncode != 0, (
    f'expected deploy.sh to abort when the config backup fails, but it exited 0: {r2.stdout!r}')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/logging.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/validate.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/backup.sh"

VERSION=""
while getopts "v:" opt; do
    case "$opt" in
        v) VERSION="$OPTARG" ;;
        *)
            log_error "usage: deploy.sh -v VERSION"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
    log_error "missing -v VERSION"
    exit 1
fi

if ! validate_version "$VERSION"; then
    exit 1
fi

if ! backup_file "config/app.conf" "$VERSION"; then
    log_error "aborting: config backup failed"
    exit 1
fi

log_info "deploying version $VERSION"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/logging.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/validate.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/backup.sh"

VERSION=""
while getopts "v:" opt; do
    case "$opt" in
        v) VERSION="$OPTARG" ;;
        *)
            log_error "usage: deploy.sh -v VERSION"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
    log_error "missing -v VERSION"
    exit 1
fi

if ! validate_version "$VERSION"; then
    exit 1
fi

backup_file "config/app.conf" "$VERSION" || true

log_info "deploying version $VERSION"
